question: A second agent can review every slice of phase 1 before it merges: it catches wrong names and untrue comments that the automatic checks cannot. It costs tokens: about 30,000 for a slice with no new names plus about 4,000 per name tested (at most 12 a slice), so a project is several hundred thousand tokens and can reach a million. Review every slice?
